description: Source code for TimescaleTimeseriesDao class implementing TimeseriesDao interface, managing time-series data storage and retrieval using TimescaleDB in a Java application.

classes.name: TimescaleTimeseriesDao
classes.description: Implementation of TimeseriesDao for TimescaleDB, managing time-series data storage, retrieval, and aggregation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the blocking queue for batch processing of time-series data.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, destroys the queue.

methods.name: findAllAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds all time-series data matching queries.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a TsKvEntry into the database, returning a future with data point days.

methods.name: savePartition
methods.description: Placeholder for saving partition data, currently returns immediate future with 0.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes data points matching the delete query.

methods.name: findAllAsync (overload)
methods.description: Finds data asynchronously based on a read query, with support for aggregation and interval types.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup based on system TTL.

methods.name: findAllWithLimit
methods.description: Retrieves limited number of data points with sorting.

methods.name: findAllAndAggregateAsync
methods.description: Retrieves and aggregates data over specified intervals.

methods.name: toResultList
methods.description: Converts list of entities to list of optional data entries.

methods.name: switchAggregation
methods.description: Performs aggregation queries based on the specified type.
